decisions.reason: The candidate already specifies exactly these two main-board input connectors with the same references, families, pitches, and pin counts; the source adds no state change.
This Requirement governs the power-board-to-main-board links, while the source describes the separate main-board-to-sensor-board connectors.
The candidate already identifies J_SENSOR_PWR as the main-to-sensor power link; the source does not change its rails, chain order, or power-distribution behavior.
The battery connector is unrelated to the two main-board-to-sensor-board connections.
The source specifies connector inventory but does not change monitored rails, monitor placement, current coverage, or monitor hardware.
The charge-status connector and indicator behavior are independent of the main-board-to-sensor-board links.
The source limits connections going to the sensor board and does not alter any panel-control, touch, button, switch, or reset connection.
The panel power-button connector remains a main-board panel connection and is not one of the connections going to the sensor board.
The source describes the sensor board's two upstream links and does not change the SPS30 SEL-to-GND mode selection.
No GPIO assignment is stated or changed by the connector-count and connector-type clarification.
The source does not change LED supply voltage, switching, data-level handling, or level-shifter requirements.
The standalone USB power behavior and LDO requirements remain unchanged by the sensor-board connector clarification.
